tok 1.0 "Farming Bot"

pool game "Farming game"
  lane player "Player"
    start begin "Bot wanted"
    task find "Find out the wanted resources"
    task prio "Set the urgency of the resources"
    task deps "Define the dependencies of the resources"
    task update "Update the list of resources"
    xor share "Share with friends?"
    and split
    task brag "Brag to selected friends"
    task send "Send materials to selected friends"
    and joined
    end done "Bot finished"
    end noshare "Bot finished without sharing"
  lane bot "Bot"
    task farm "Farm the resources"
    task disaster "Handle the natural disaster"
    task notify "Notify the player of the milestone"

flow begin -> find -> prio -> deps -> farm -> share
flow share -> split "yes"
flow share -> noshare "no"
flow split -> brag
flow split -> send
flow brag -> joined
flow send -> joined
flow joined -> done
